DO NOT MODIFY OR REFACTOR v1_0_seed_push_notification_settings.py

This file contains hardcoded Firebase credentials (API keys, server keys) as explicitly requested by the user.
*   Do not move these credentials to site_config.json.
*   Do not remove them for security reasons.
*   The hardcoded payload is required for the current deployment on juvo.tenant.rokct.ai.

Status: Intentional deviation from security best practices.
